result.boundary: Automatic occlusion mode takes one raster round below the cluster threshold; forced modes and the forced-threshold test keep two-phase covered. Lap comparisons are steady-state within one browser session; the first-tour comparison uses separate sessions. Sessions differ by several percent, so only rows of one report are compared. Command costs were measured on a busy machine. Disturbed and failed runs are kept. Full enabled performance acceptance stays open.
